assertions.note: machine draft golden (goldgate, 2026-10-13; to be confirmed by the user): drafted from zoomed crops of the render, then checked against both engines; no delivered output exists for this page yet. Scan 34 = printed folio 31, section 五 of 明志's 江西共匪的內幕一斑: ### 五、共匪在江西的軍隊及其活動 (magazine #, article ##), one paragraph ending 已有下表之多：, then the start of a table of Red Army units printed in vertical columns, written as HTML one record per row (朱德, 毛澤東, 彭德懷, 黃公略, 方志敏, 周子昆) under a 2-row header (統系姓名, 僞銜名, 組織, 實力 colspan 2 over 人數/槍數, 老巢, 出沒地點, 主力現在位置); small two-line and 4x7 cell text joined in reading order, blank cells empty. Figures as printed in Western digits: 5000/3000, 3000/1500, 1000/400, 1000/800, 2000/400 餘 (engine A wrote 150 and 80 at faint 0s; engine B lost 13 of 14). Printed forms: 衞, 尙 (the p.2 glyph), 査, 黃, 峯, 粵, 僞; 已 although the type closes its corner like 巳. Kept as printed: 安春 (the next cell prints 宜春), 上餘 (for 上饒), 秀水, 磨蓋山, 富口. The bracketed pair in 方志敏's 老巢 is set horizontally right to left, as the running head is, so it is written 磨蓋山（已破）; both engines read 破已. The side line beside 江西 (a proper-name mark) is not written. Running head 剷共半月刊 第四期, folio 31 and the seal are not text. OPEN: the table continues on scans 35-36 (13 more records); under the merged-table rule this page-only golden fails a correctly merged output and should become pages-0034-0036.
